source.text:
If your Army Faction is **WORLD EATERS**, at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll. To do so, roll eight D6. You can then use those dice to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne (see below). Each Blessing of Khorne specifies the dice results it requires (where a number is specified, a double or triple of that value or higher is required). You can only activate each Blessing of Khorne once per battle round. Any unused dice from the Blessings of Khorne roll are then discarded. Once activated, each Blessing of Khorne applies to all units from your army with this ability until the end of the battle round.
*Example: Ash makes a Blessings of Khorne roll, getting the following: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 6.*
*First they use the two 6s to activate Warp Blades (which requires a double 5+), leaving the following dice: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4.*
*They then use the two 2s to activate Unbridled Bloodlust.*
*Now that two Blessings of Khorne have been activated, no more can be activated and the remaining dice are discarded.*
Unbridled Bloodlust · double 1+: This unit has +1 to **charge rolls**.
Rage-fuelled Invigoration · double 2+: Each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or **Consolidation move**, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
Total Carnage · double 3+: Each time a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Martial Excellence · double 4+ or triple 1+: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.
Warp Blades · double 5+ or triple 2+: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.
Decapitating Strikes · double 6 or triple 3+: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an **INFANTRY** unit, that attack has the **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** ability.

If your Army Faction is **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS**, at the end of the Read Mission Objectives step, you must determine your army’s Oath for the coming battle. An Oath consists of two parts - one Deed and one Quality. There are three options for each part, shown below.
To determine your army’s Deed, you can either select one Deed or you can randomly select one Deed by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table below. The selected Deed will describe what needs to be achieved in order to complete that Deed.
To determine your army’s Quality, you can either select one Quality or you can randomly select one Quality by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table below. Until the end of the battle, the ability described in the Quality selected applies to all models in your army with this ability.
The first time your selected Deed is completed your Oath is fulfilled and, until the end of the battle, your army becomes Honoured and you gain 2CP, or 3CP if you randomly selected your Deed and/or Quality (CP gained in this way are an exemption to the Core Rules that limit the maximum number of CP you can gain per battle round to 1).
Deed 1–2 · We vow to lay low the tyrant…: At the start of the battle, select one **CHARACTER** model in your opponent’s army. This Deed is completed at the end of a turn if that **CHARACTER** is destroyed.
Deed 3–4 · We swear to reclaim the realm…: This deed is completed at the end of your opponent’s turn if you control more objective markers than your opponent.
Deed 5–6 · We pledge to reap a great tally…: This deed is completed at the end of the battle round if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than the battle round number even if those units are subsequently returned to the battlefield (for example, two destroyed enemy units in the first battle round).
Quality 1–2 · …with our martial valour risen over all: Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one **Hit roll** and you can re-roll one **Wound roll**.
Quality 3–4 · …and we are eager for the challenge: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic and add 1 to **Advance** and **Charge rolls** made for this model.
Quality 5–6 · …yet shall our legacy be unsullied: Improve this model’s Objective Control characteristic by 2 and its Leadership characteristic by 1.

If your Army Faction is **CHAOS KNIGHTS**, each unit from your army with this ability gains Dread abilities, depending which are active for your army (see below). The Deathly Terror ability is active for your army from the start of the battle. In addition, at the start of the first, third and fifth battle rounds, you can either select one of the other Dread abilities or randomly select two Dread abilities to apply by rolling two D6 and applying the results rolled, from those numbered 1-6.

Deathly Terror (Aura) · N/A: While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.
Despair (Aura) · 1: While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. This is cumulative with the Deathly Terror ability (see above).
Doom · 2: Each time this model makes an attack, if the target of that attack is **Battle-shocked**, add 1 to the **Wound roll**.
Darkness · 3: This model has **Stealth**.
Dismay (Aura) · 4: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, for each enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 9" of this model, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
Delirium (Aura) · 5: While an enemy unit that is **Below Half-strength** is within 9" of this model, each time that unit fails a Battle-shock test, it suffers D3 **mortal wounds**.
Dominion · 6: Add 3" to the range of this model’s **Aura abilities**.

- Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
- Models in this unit have the **Feel No Pain 6+** ability.

We recommend placing a token next to each **readied** unit, removing it when that unit is no longer **readied**.
**Favoured Ka’tah**
All **detachments** tagged ‘Unique: Shield Host’ state a Favoured Ka’tah. If you selected one of these **detachments**, the **ka’tah ability** that is the Favoured Ka’tah of that **detachment** grants the additional effect listed in that **detachment**.
**Example:** If you selected the Solar Watch **detachment**, when you select the Calistus **ka’tah ability** for a **readied** unit, that unit has +2" **M** in addition to the normal effect of Calistus.

- Being **engaged**/**battle-shocked** does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
- Starting an action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

**WHEN:** Your Movement phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is selected to move.

**EFFECT:** Your unit’s melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding **MONSTER**/**VEHICLE** units) can **re-roll hit rolls** of 1.

**WHEN:** Start of the Fight phase.
**TARGET:** One friendly **readied** unit.
**EFFECT:** Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
Rendax: KA’TAH ABILITY

Each **ka’tah ability** will tell you when that **ka’tah ability** can be used, and the effects that **ka’tah ability** has on the unit using it.
We recommend placing a token next to each **readied** unit, removing it when that unit is no longer **readied**.
**Favoured Ka’tah**
All **detachments** tagged ‘Unique: Shield Host’ state a Favoured Ka’tah. If you selected one of these **detachments**, the **ka’tah ability** that is the Favoured Ka’tah of that **detachment** grants the additional effect listed in that **detachment**.
**Example:** If you selected the Solar Watch **detachment**, when you select the Calistus **ka’tah ability** for a **readied** unit, that unit has +2" **M** in addition to the normal effect of Calistus.
Conservai: KA’TAH ABILITY
**WHEN:** Your Command phase.
**TARGET:** One friendly **readied** unit.
**EFFECT:** Until the end of the turn:
- Being **engaged**/**battle-shocked** does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
- Starting an action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
Calistus: KA’TAH ABILITY
**WHEN:** Your Movement phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is selected to move.
**TARGET:** That **readied** unit.
**EFFECT:** When your unit makes a normal/advance/fall-back move, your unit can move through all types of model.
Salvus: KA’TAH ABILITY
**WHEN:** Your Shooting phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is selected to shoot.
**TARGET:** That **readied** unit.
**EFFECT:** Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
- **BS.**
- Hit rolls and wound rolls.
Dacatarai: KA’TAH ABILITY
**WHEN:** Start of the Fight phase.
**TARGET:** One friendly **readied** unit.
**EFFECT:** Your unit’s melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding **MONSTER**/**VEHICLE** units) can **re-roll hit rolls** of 1.
Kaptaris: KA’TAH ABILITY
**WHEN:** Start of the Fight phase.
**TARGET:** One friendly **readied** unit.
**EFFECT:** Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
Rendax: KA’TAH ABILITY
**WHEN:** Fight phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is selected to fight.
**TARGET:** One friendly **readied** unit.
**EFFECT:** Your unit’s melee attacks have **[Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle]**.
